تفتحلون (form VIII)
# تَفْتَحِلُونَ (taftaḥilūna) /taf.ta.ħi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# تُفْتَحَلُونَ (tuftaḥalūna) /tuf.ta.ħa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
